title: How to Change Industries Without Starting Over
status: Reference assets built and rendered in this batch. Not finished motion graphics.
note: No prior rendered V8 to V13 artwork exists. Every PNG here is a new build from a reusable concept, not a byte-identical reuse.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: DESTINATION, from the Attachment B spec, rebuilt on the sentence the hook actually quotes.
teaching_assets.purpose: Puts the exact sentence from the job description on screen, which is the tension the whole video answers.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Quoted line alone for 1.6s. Support line at 2.2s.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the two mistakes.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft impact as the quote lands.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: New. The script names two opposite errors and no Attachment B asset carried both.
teaching_assets.trigger: So do not make either mistake.
teaching_assets.onscreen: I can already do all of this / None of my experience counts here
teaching_assets.purpose: Names both failure modes before the framework, so the framework arrives as the alternative.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column on the first mistake, right column on the second. Closing line at 3.4s.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The closing line leads into the framework.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the framework.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one restrained accent on the closing line.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: THREE_PART_READ, from the Attachment B spec. The hero framework.
teaching_assets.purpose: The hero framework. Returns briefly at each section change.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One word at a time, 0.9s apart. Closing line at 3.2s. Hold the complete set.
teaching_assets.hold: 9 to 11 seconds first time, 3 seconds on each return.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent per word, then a resolve. Or one resolve only.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: New. The script's sharpest transfer warning and no Attachment B asset carried it.
teaching_assets.trigger: “Approve” can mean checking a routine item in one role and accepting a consequential risk in another.
teaching_assets.onscreen: APPROVE: checking a routine item / APPROVE: accepting a consequential risk
teaching_assets.purpose: Stops the viewer from claiming equivalence off a shared verb.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column first, 1.6s. Right column with the weight. Closing line at 3.6s.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The right column, then the closing line.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the capability sentence.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent as the right column arrives.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: A constructed comparison, not a claim about any real employer's approval rules.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: CONTEXT, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own list.
teaching_assets.onscreen: Customer or user / Operating model / Standards and approval routes / Stakeholders / Relationships / Consequences of error
teaching_assets.purpose: Makes context concrete instead of a vague word.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Two at a time, 1.0s apart, then the closing line. Do not reveal six separate states.
teaching_assets.emphasis: Even weight. The list is not a barrier count, and the spoken line that follows says so.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 11 seconds. Six items need real reading time.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the better question to ask.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent when the list completes. Not one per item.
teaching_assets.build_note: Two deliberate reductions, both for phone legibility rather than for space. The script also names Tools, which is left off so the remaining six stay large, and it is still spoken. The follow-on line, not every difference is a barrier of equal size, is also spoken rather than set as a footer, because keeping it on the frame forced the type down.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: REQUIREMENTS, from the Attachment B spec. The credential triage.
teaching_assets.onscreen: CONFIRMED REQUIREMENT / PREFERRED QUALIFICATION / STILL UNCLEAR
teaching_assets.purpose: Turns a vague credential worry into three sortable buckets.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One row at a time, 1.1s apart. Closing line after a beat, at display weight.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the defensible introduction.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one flat accent per row, or one on the closing line only.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: DESTINATION_READ, from the Attachment B spec, reduced to the three-part shape the script names.
teaching_assets.trigger: It shows the shape of the decision:
teaching_assets.onscreen: RELEVANT EVIDENCE / NAMED LEARNING / VERIFIED REQUIREMENTS
teaching_assets.purpose: The deliverable. What a careful introduction contains.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One at a time, 1.0s apart. Closing line at 3.4s.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the tradeoff questions.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent as the set completes.

teaching_assets.trigger: The Capability Formation Field Kit is linked below for a broader evidence-led read of what your current work is building and what you may be able to carry.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the Watch Next bridge.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one warm accent on the URL.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The support line is the script's own limit. Keep it.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: Separate Watch Next card. Final visual.
teaching_assets.trigger: Watch “Before a Layoff, Know What You Can Still Prove” next.
teaching_assets.onscreen: WATCH NEXT: BEFORE A LAYOFF, KNOW WHAT YOU CAN STILL PROVE
teaching_assets.purpose: Final visual. Right of frame kept clear for the end-screen element.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 14 seconds, through the final spoken line and the closing hold.
teaching_assets.exit: NONE. Final visual. No camera return, no outro.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none, then a natural music fade.
